Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where an IdentityHashMap is used with a boxed Integer as the key. This is risky because boxing may produce distinct instances, leading to the map.get(n) returning null even though a value was previously put in the map.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered in the testShowBug method when assertNotNull is used to check the result of IdentityHashMapBoxingBug.showBug(). This is because the showBug method uses an IdentityHashMap with a boxed Integer as the key, which is risky and can yield unexpected results due to boxing producing distinct instances.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test ran successfully without any assertion errors, which means the'showBug()' method did not return null. This indicates that the same instance of Integer was used for both putting and getting from the IdentityHashMap, which is the expected behavior and not a sign of the 'IdentityHashMapBoxing' bug.
